kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تحتضرن (form VIII)
# تَحْتَضِرْنَ (taḥtaḍirna) /taħ.ta.dˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# تُحْتَضَرْنَ (tuḥtaḍarna) /tuħ.ta.dˤar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
